title: PAF Design System / Theming Contract (Step 23)
description: Enforces data-driven theming: visual look-and-feel is swappable via tokens without touching structure, and feature logic never lives in the theme layer.

rule.const: Tokens carry appearance values only. A token may never encode a business rule, threshold, or feature condition.
A theme is a named set of token values. Swapping a theme changes appearance only; it never changes what a component does or which data it shows.
Component structure, behavior, and data binding are independent of the active theme and are never generated from theme content.

layerSeparationRule.const: No magic numbers in the render layer: colors, bands, thresholds, and formats arrive via spec or token, never hardcoded (chart ground rule 11).

baselineRule.const: Every shared control and screen has an approved visual baseline. A rendered difference from baseline is a defect unless the baseline itself is changed through a governed workflow.

visualRegressionRule.const: Visual regression evidence is DETERMINISTIC: same input yields identical pixels, stable sort and category order, no random jitter (chart ground rule 10).
